title: Name card template
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Special days, summer and numbers
source: Written for arabic/y3 lesson 1 (Name card template (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 1: Bridge: my name, and this and that. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Asking a name
points: مَا اسْمُكَ؟ (ma smuka?) to a boy
مَا اسْمُكِ؟ (ma smuki?) to a girl

panels.title: This and that
points: هٰذَا كِتَابٌ (hadha kitabun) = this is a book
ذٰلِكَ بَابٌ (dhalika babun) = that is a door

box.title: Write اِسْمِي and your name in Arabic letters, then decorate the card with shapes and patterns

keywords.def: what is your name? (to a boy)

questions.q: A pen is near you. Say: This is a pen.
Core: Write اِسْمِي (ismi) and your name in Arabic letters, three times neatly.
Extend: Write هٰذَا كِتَابٌ and ذٰلِكَ بَابٌ and say what each means.
questions.a: This is a book. That is a door.

questions.q: Stretch: Write a short talk: salam, ask a name, give your name.
The book is far away. Which word do we use?
questions.a: B) ذٰلِكَ (dhalika). ذٰلِكَ (dhalika) points to something far away; هٰذَا (hadha) is for near.

questions.q: What does اِسْمِي (ismi) mean? A) my name is B) this is C) that is
Big question: how do I tell someone who I am in Arabic?
questions.a: Say salam, then اِسْمِي (ismi) and my name.
